title: LungDepo: Modelling the regional particle deposition in the human lung via the Enalos Cloud Platform

This work presents the development of LungDepo,a freely accessible online web application hosted on the Enalos Cloud Platform (https://enaloscloud.novamechanics.com/proplanet/lungdeposition), which enables users to simulate particle deposition in the human lung...
